description: Original source file of game-binary functions, read from the debug records (DWARF 1 / ECOFF mdebug) of other PS2 builds that link the same code byte-for-byte modulo relocation. Keyed by the original file's basename; `functions` are function starts in the current split of SLUS_215.03. `split_hints` are addresses where another build starts a function that the current split does not (a missed or merged function boundary). Evidence only: the repo layout is not changed by this file.
confidence: every prototype with a procedure record for the matched function names the same file and the same function name; range-only hits excluded
